about.title: About Me
about.description: I am a Full Stack Developer with 5 years of experience in strategic projects. My main expertise is in Java Spring Boot and Angular, with strong skills in React, Node.js, and Cloud (AWS and Azure). I enjoy building scalable and high-quality applications, applying best practices, automated testing, and performance optimization. I have contributed to impactful national projects such as the National Register of Missing Persons (CNPD – Ministry of Justice).

qintess.text: At Qintess, I worked as a Full Stack Developer on critical systems for the Ministry of Justice. I developed APIs and applications using Java Spring Boot and Angular, implemented CI/CD pipelines with Docker, Kubernetes, and Azure DevOps, and optimized SQL queries. I also introduced unit and integration testing to ensure greater security and reliability in deliveries.

cwi.text: At CWI Software, I developed solutions for Banco Votorantim and CIEE-RS, working with Java, Spring Boot, Angular, and React in a microservices architecture. I handled messaging with Kafka, monitoring with Grafana and Prometheus, and integrations with SQL and NoSQL databases. I also worked on AWS and Azure cloud provisioning with DevOps practices, implemented automated tests, and participated in code reviews.
